title: Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – April 28, 2026

note:
### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – April 28, 2026

#### Bug Fix Update

This is a bug fix update. Replay codes have been wiped.

#### 4v4 Evolved

4v4 Evolved is a limited time team deathmatch where it's all Emres with even starts, tweaked to make everyone a little more lethal when you lock in. That's right - it's Emre vs Emre, slaying each other in classic FPS style: spawn, engage, adapt, repeat. Put your skills to the test and finish the fight from April 28 - May 11!

#### Bug Fixes

General

* Fixed an issue where players were unable to jump while the scoreboard was open.
* Fixed an issue where Ramattra's ultimate could sometimes play louder than intended.
note_cn:
### 《守望先锋》正式服补丁说明 – 2026年4月28日

#### 错误修复更新

本次为错误修复更新。录像代码已被清空。

#### 4v4 进化模式

“4v4 进化模式”是一项限时团队死斗活动，所有玩家都将使用埃姆雷并在相同的起点出发。我们对数值进行了微调，让你在锁定目标时更具杀伤力。没错——这就是埃姆雷对阵埃姆雷，以经典的FPS风格相互厮杀：重生、交战、适应、循环。在4月28日至5月11日期间，考验你的技巧并终结战斗吧！

#### 错误修复

综合

* 修复了玩家在打开计分板时无法跳跃的问题。
* 修复了拉玛刹的终极技能音效有时会比预想中更大的问题。
